Northwind Labs is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer (fully remote, US).

What you'll do:
- Design and build TypeScript services on Node.js.
- Own our PostgreSQL schema and migrations.
- Mentor other engineers.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of backend experience.
- Strong TypeScript and Node.js.
- Production PostgreSQL experience.
- Experience with Kubernetes.

Pay: $165,000 – $185,000 base. No on-call rotation.
